title: Practical insights into controlling exponential concentration in quantum machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27486v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) models are often limited by exponential concentration, where quantum observables become insensitive to input variations as system size increases. In this work, we provide a comparative empirical study of this phenomenon across Fidelity Quantum Kernels (FQK), Projected Quantum Kernels (PQK), and Quantum Extreme Learning (QEL), within a unified observable-based framework based on expectation-value variance. We investigate how measurement locality, entanglement, and circuit expressivity shape concentration across different architectures. Global fidelity-based kernels exhibit strong concentration driven by Hilbert space dimensionality, whereas local-observable approaches reduce but do not eliminate this effect. In PQK and QEL, concentration is primarily governed by entanglement and quantum dynamical expressivity, with reservoir depth emerging as a key factor in QEL architectures. translated_title: 量子机器学习中控制指数集中的实用见解
translated_abstract: 量子机器学习（QML）模型常常受到指数集中现象的限制，即随着系统规模的增大，量子可观测量对输入变化变得不敏感。在这项工作中，我们在一个基于期望值方差的统一可观测框架内，对这一现象在保真度量子核（FQK）、投影量子核（PQK）和量子极限学习（QEL）三类架构中的表现进行了比较实证研究。我们研究了测量局域性、纠缠和电路表达能力如何在不同架构中塑造集中现象。基于全局保真度的核函数表现出由希尔伯特空间维度驱动的强集中现象，而局域可观测方法可以缓解但无法完全消除这一效应。在PQK和QEL中，集中现象主要由纠缠和量子动力学表达能力决定，其中储备池深度成为QEL架构中的一个关键因素。我们进一步研究了带宽……
tldr: 该论文在基于期望值方差的统一框架下实证比较了三类量子机器学习架构中的指数集中现象，发现全局保真度核因希尔伯特空间维度而强烈集中，而测量局域性、纠缠调控和储备池深度等设计手段可以缓解但无法完全消除这一效应。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a comparative empirical study of exponential concentration across FQK, PQK, and QEL architectures within a unified observable-based framework, showing that global fidelity kernels concentrate strongly due to Hilbert space dimensionality, while measurement locality, entanglement, and reservoir depth can mitigate but not eliminate the effect.
